mission_intel.what_is_it: Minor security freeze placed across the 3 major credit reporting bureaus (Experian, TransUnion, Equifax) and ChexSystems bank account verification service.
mission_intel.why_you_need_it: TOTAL IDENTITY THEFT DEFENSE: Over 1.25 million children are victims of synthetic identity theft each year. Fraudsters steal infant SSNs to open fraudulent credit cards, auto loans, and mortgages that go undetected for 18 years. A credit freeze locks Aiden's credit file completely until he turns 18.
mission_intel.deadline_urgency: T+14d to T+60d (as soon as SSN card arrives). Free by federal law under the Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act.
execution_steps: 1. Download and fill minor credit freeze packets for Experian, TransUnion, and Equifax.
2. Include certified copy of Aiden's Birth Certificate and sponsor government ID.
3. Mail via USPS Certified Mail to each bureau's minor dispute center.
4. Store generated 6-digit PIN codes safely in family lockbox until age 18.

mission_intel.why_you_need_it: IMMEDIATE CASH FLOW BOOST: Instead of waiting 14 months for your annual IRS tax refund, adjusting Step 3 of your W-4 in myPay reduces monthly federal withholding by ~$166.67/month, giving your family immediate monthly liquidity.
mission_intel.deadline_urgency: Can be executed any time post-birth in myPay; recommended by T+30d to capture full calendar year benefit.

tasks.title: Dependent Care FSA (DCFSA) 60-Day QLE Enrollment (Deadline: Jan 5, 2027)
tasks.sla: HARD 60-DAY WINDOW CLOSES 2027-01-05
checklists: Evaluate 2026/2027 childcare need & open QLE on https://www.fsafeds.gov/ before 2027-01-05

tasks.notes: STRICT 60-DAY WINDOW CLOSES 2027-01-05. Maximize $5,000 pre-tax deduction to save ~$1,500–$2,000 on childcare. Enroll via FSAFEDS.gov using Aiden's birth record.

mission_intel.what_is_it: A Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (DCFSA) is an IRS-authorized pre-tax benefit account administered via FSAFEDS (for military service members and federal DoD civilians) that lets you set aside up to $5,000 per family per year in pre-tax payroll deductions to pay for eligible childcare and dependent care expenses.
mission_intel.why_you_need_it: MASSIVE 30%–35% TAX SAVINGS (~$1,500 – $2,000 CASH BACK PER YEAR): Every dollar contributed to your DCFSA is deducted from your military pay BEFORE federal income tax, state income tax (VA 5.75%), and FICA/Medicare are calculated. Maxing out the $5,000 annual limit reduces your federal/state taxable income by $5,000, putting $1,500 to $2,000 of cash directly back in your family's pocket instead of giving it to the IRS.
mission_intel.deadline_urgency: STRICT 60-DAY QUALIFYING LIFE EVENT (QLE) DEADLINE — JANUARY 5, 2027: Under IRS rules, employees cannot enroll in an FSA mid-year without a Qualifying Life Event. The birth of Baby Aiden on November 6, 2026 creates a one-time 60-calendar-day enrollment window. IF YOU MISS JANUARY 5, 2027, YOU ARE LOCKED OUT UNTIL THE NEXT ANNUAL OPEN SEASON (November 2027 for Plan Year 2028), losing up to $2,000 in tax deductions.
mission_intel.qualifying_expenses: Eligible expenses include: licensed child care centers / infant daycares (including DoD Child Development Centers at Fort Belvoir, JBAB, and Pentagon), nursery schools, licensed family child care homes, full-time nannies / in-home babysitters (while parents work), and preschools.
execution_steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.fsafeds.gov/ and log in or register via Login.gov.
2. Select 'Enroll Through a Qualifying Life Event (QLE)'.
3. Select QLE Type: 'Birth / Adoption of a Child' and enter Aiden's Date of Birth: 2026-11-06.
4. Enter your annual dependent care election amount (up to $5,000 / $416.66 per month).
5. Upload supporting documentation: ATAMMC Certificate of Live Birth or Hospital Discharge packet within 30 days of submitting the QLE.
6. FSAFEDS transmits payroll deduction instructions directly to DFAS / myPay.
